name: sparkrun
description: Launch, manage, and stop recipe-based inference workloads on single-node or multi-node DGX Spark setups.
compatibility: vLLM, SGLang, and llama.cpp recipes; SSH-based node management.
limitations: Setup can change SSH, sudoers, and host services; review the recipe and requested permissions.
Anonymous usage telemetry is on by default; SPARKRUN_NO_TELEMETRY=1 disables it for one process.
The bundled SparkRoute integration has separate AGPL licensing; check the selected channel's defaults.

sources.note: Upstream description, setup, and documented requirements.
